recipes.title: Slow-cooker white chicken chili
recipes.blurb: Creamy, mild and cozy, with shredded chicken and white beans

steps.text: Put the chicken in the slow cooker. Season with the cumin, oregano, salt and pepper.
Add the onion, garlic, green chiles and drained beans on top.
Pour in the broth, cover, and cook on low for 6 hours.
Check the chicken is 165°F inside. Lift it out and shred it with two forks.
Stir the chicken back in with the cream cheese. Cover until the cheese melts.
Stir well. Top with cilantro and a squeeze of lime, and serve.

recipes.title: Lemon salmon with green beans
recipes.blurb: Sheet-pan salmon and crisp green beans, ready in 30 minutes

steps.text: Heat the oven to 400°F. Line a sheet pan with foil.
Toss the green beans with 1 tbsp oil and half the salt and pepper. Spread them on the pan.
Roast the green beans by themselves first.
Push the beans to the sides. Add the salmon, brush with the rest of the oil and garlic, and season.
Sprinkle with dill and lay lemon slices on top. Bake until the salmon is 145°F and flakes easily.
Squeeze the lemon juice over everything and serve.

recipes.title: Chicken noodle soup
recipes.blurb: The classic: tender chicken, carrots and egg noodles

steps.text: Melt the butter in a large pot over medium heat. Cook the onion, carrots and celery until soft.
Add the garlic and thyme and stir for 1 minute.
Pour in the broth, add the whole chicken breasts, and bring to a boil.
Turn the heat to low, cover, and simmer until the chicken is 165°F inside.
Lift out the chicken and shred it with two forks.
Add the noodles to the pot and simmer until tender.
Stir the chicken back in. Taste, add salt and pepper, and serve.

recipes.title: Skillet pork chops with apples
recipes.blurb: Seared chops with cinnamon-brown sugar apples

steps.text: Pat the chops dry. Season both sides with salt, pepper and garlic powder.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high. Add the chops and leave them alone to brown.
Flip and cook until a thermometer reads 145°F in the middle.
Move the chops to a plate and cover loosely with foil. They rest while you cook the apples.
Turn the heat to medium. Add the butter, apples, brown sugar and cinnamon. Cook until soft.
Pour in the broth and scrape up the brown bits. Simmer until a little syrupy.
Put the chops back with their juices, spoon the apples over, and serve.

recipes.title: Tomato soup and grilled cheese
recipes.blurb: Creamy homemade tomato soup with golden cheddar sandwiches

steps.text: Melt the butter in a pot over medium heat. Cook the onion until soft.
Stir in the garlic for 1 minute. Add the tomatoes, broth, sugar and basil.
Bring to a boil, then turn the heat to low and simmer.
Meanwhile, butter one side of each bread slice. Make 4 sandwiches, cheese inside, butter outside.
Cook the sandwiches in a skillet over medium-low until golden, then flip and cook the other side.
Turn off the soup. Blend it smooth with a stick blender, then stir in the cream.
Cut the sandwiches in half and serve with the soup for dipping.

recipes.title: Sheet-pan sausage and vegetables
recipes.blurb: Smoked sausage, potatoes and broccoli on one pan

steps.text: Heat the oven to 425°F. Line a large sheet pan with foil.
Toss the potatoes on the pan with 1 tbsp oil and half the seasonings. Roast them alone first.
Meanwhile, toss the sausage, broccoli, pepper and onion with the rest of the oil and seasonings.
Add them to the pan, stir everything together, and spread it out.
Roast until the potatoes are tender and the sausage is browned and hot.
Serve hot, with mustard for dipping if you like.

recipes.title: Crispy baked chicken tenders
recipes.blurb: Panko-crunchy tenders, no frying, with honey mustard

steps.text: Heat the oven to 425°F. Set a wire rack on a sheet pan and coat it with cooking spray.
Mix the panko, Parmesan, garlic powder, paprika and salt in a shallow dish.
Dredge each tender in flour, then egg, then the panko mix. Press the crumbs on.
Set the tenders on the rack and spray the tops well with cooking spray.
Bake until golden and 165°F inside, flipping once halfway.
Serve hot with the honey mustard.

recipes.title: Oven-fried chicken drumsticks
recipes.blurb: Crunchy-skinned drumsticks, baked until juicy

steps.text: Toss the drumsticks in the buttermilk in a big bowl. Let them sit while the oven heats.
Heat the oven to 425°F. Line a sheet pan with foil and set a rack on top.
Mix the flour, paprika, garlic powder, salt and pepper in a bag or dish.
Shake off extra buttermilk, then coat each drumstick in the flour mix.
Place them on the rack and drizzle with the melted butter.
Bake, turning once, until deep golden and 175°F near the bone.
Rest 5 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Honey garlic chicken thighs
recipes.blurb: Sticky sweet-savory glaze, one skillet

steps.text: Season the thighs with salt and pepper. Whisk the honey, soy sauce, garlic and vinegar in a bowl.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high. Brown the thighs.
Flip the thighs and cook the second side until golden.
Pour the sauce over the chicken. Cover and simmer on low until 175°F inside.
Move the chicken to a plate. Stir the cornstarch into the water, then into the pan.
Simmer until the sauce is glossy and thick. Spoon over the chicken.

recipes.title: Oven BBQ chicken drumsticks
recipes.blurb: Sticky barbecue chicken without the grill

steps.text: Heat the oven to 425°F. Line a sheet pan with foil and spray a rack or the foil.
Toss the drumsticks with the oil, paprika, garlic powder, salt and pepper.
Bake the drumsticks, turning once.
Brush with half the barbecue sauce. Bake again until sticky.
Turn, brush with the rest of the sauce, and bake until 175°F near the bone.
Rest 5 minutes and serve.

recipes.title: Classic roast chicken and potatoes
recipes.blurb: Sunday-style whole bird with crisp skin and golden potatoes

steps.text: Heat the oven to 425°F. Pat the chicken very dry, inside and out. Remove any giblets.
Rub the butter under and over the skin. Season with salt, pepper and thyme.
Put the lemon and garlic in the cavity. Set the chicken in a roasting pan.
Toss the potatoes and carrots with the oil, salt and pepper. Scatter around the bird.
Roast until a thermometer in the thigh reads 165°F, about 1 hour 15 minutes.
Rest the chicken under foil before carving.
Carve and serve with the vegetables and pan juices.

recipes.title: Honey mustard chicken and broccoli
recipes.blurb: Thighs, potatoes and broccoli roasted on one pan

steps.text: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the potatoes with 1 tbsp oil, salt and pepper on a large sheet pan.
Roast the potatoes by themselves first.
Whisk the mustard, honey, garlic and 1 tbsp oil. Toss the thighs in half of it.
Push the potatoes aside. Add the thighs skin-side up. Roast.
Toss the broccoli with the last 1 tbsp oil. Add to the pan and roast until the chicken is 175°F.
Drizzle the rest of the sauce over the chicken and serve.

recipes.title: Creamy garlic chicken skillet
recipes.blurb: Seared chicken in a quick garlic-Parmesan cream sauce

steps.text: Season the chicken with salt and pepper.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high. Cook the chicken until golden and 165°F inside.
Move the chicken to a plate. Add the garlic to the pan and stir for 30 seconds.
Pour in the broth and cream. Simmer until slightly thickened.
Stir in the Parmesan and spinach until the spinach wilts.
Return the chicken to the pan, warm through, and serve over pasta or rice.

recipes.title: Air fryer crispy chicken thighs
recipes.blurb: Shatter-crisp skin in under 30 minutes

steps.text: Heat the air fryer to 380°F. Pat the thighs very dry.
Rub the thighs with the oil, then the paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, salt and pepper.
Place skin-side down in the basket in one layer. Work in two batches if needed.
Cook skin-side down.
Flip skin-side up and cook until 175°F inside and crisp.
Rest 5 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Pan-seared lemon herb chicken breasts
recipes.blurb: Juicy breasts with a fast lemon butter pan sauce

ingredients.item: boneless skinless chicken breasts (6 oz each)

steps.text: Pound the breasts to an even thickness. Season both sides with salt, pepper and thyme.
Heat the oil and 1 tbsp butter in a large skillet over medium-high. Cook the chicken.
Flip and cook until 165°F inside. Move the chicken to a plate.
Lower the heat. Add the garlic and cook 30 seconds. Pour in the broth and lemon juice.
Simmer until reduced by half, then whisk in the last 2 tbsp butter.
Return the chicken, spoon sauce over, and add the lemon slices. Serve.

recipes.title: Classic glazed meatloaf
recipes.blurb: Tender, ketchup-glazed and made for leftover sandwiches

steps.text: Heat the oven to 350°F. Line a sheet pan with foil.
Stir the panko and milk together in a large bowl for 5 minutes.
Add the beef, onion, garlic, eggs, Worcestershire, salt, pepper and 1/4 cup ketchup. Mix gently.
Shape into a loaf about 9 by 5 inches on the pan. Mix the rest of the ketchup with the brown sugar.
Spread the glaze over the loaf. Bake until 160°F in the middle.
Rest 10 minutes, then slice.

recipes.title: Slow-cooker pot roast
recipes.blurb: Fall-apart beef with carrots and potatoes

steps.text: Pat the roast dry and rub it all over with the salt and pepper.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high. Sear the roast on all sides until deep brown.
Put the onion, carrots and potatoes in the slow cooker. Set the roast on top.
Whisk the broth, tomato paste and Worcestershire. Pour over and add the thyme.
Cover and cook on low until the roast shreds easily.
Lift out the roast and vegetables. Shred the beef and serve with the juices.

recipes.title: Salisbury steak with mushroom gravy
recipes.blurb: Beef patties in rich onion-mushroom gravy

steps.text: Mix the beef, panko, egg, Worcestershire, salt and pepper. Shape into 4 oval patties.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high. Brown the patties on both sides.
Move the patties to a plate. Cook the mushrooms and onion in the same pan until soft.
Sprinkle in the flour and stir for 1 minute. Slowly pour in the broth, stirring.
Return the patties to the gravy. Cover and simmer until 160°F inside.
Serve over mashed potatoes or egg noodles.

recipes.title: Garlic butter steak bites
recipes.blurb: Seared sirloin cubes, ready in 20 minutes

steps.text: Pat the steak cubes dry. Season with salt and pepper.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over high heat until it shimmers.
Sear the steak in one layer without moving it. Work in two batches.
Turn the pieces and sear until browned. Medium is 135°F.
Lower the heat. Add the butter and garlic and stir for 30 seconds.
Toss the steak in the butter, sprinkle with parsley, and serve.

recipes.title: Oven-baked BBQ ribs
recipes.blurb: Tender, slow-baked ribs with sticky sauce

ingredients.item: racks baby back ribs (about 2 lb each)

steps.text: Heat the oven to 275°F. Peel the thin membrane off the back of each rack.
Mix the brown sugar, paprika, garlic powder, salt and pepper. Rub it all over the ribs.
Wrap each rack tightly in foil and set on a sheet pan.
Bake until the meat is very tender.
Unwrap, brush with sauce, and set the oven to broil. Broil until bubbly and sticky.
Rest 5 minutes, then cut between the bones.

recipes.title: Roasted pork tenderloin and vegetables
recipes.blurb: Garlicky tenderloin with potatoes and carrots

steps.text: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the potatoes and carrots with 2 tbsp oil, half the salt and pepper on a sheet pan.
Roast the vegetables by themselves first.
Rub the pork with 1 tbsp oil, garlic, rosemary and the rest of the salt and pepper.
Push the vegetables aside and set the pork in the middle of the pan.
Roast until the pork is 145°F in the thickest part.
Rest the pork 5 minutes, slice, and serve with the vegetables.

recipes.title: Beef tips and gravy
recipes.blurb: Tender steak tips in onion gravy over egg noodles

steps.text: Season the beef with salt and pepper. Sear in 1 tbsp hot oil in batches until browned. Set aside.
In the same pan add the last 1 tbsp oil, onion and mushrooms. Cook until soft.
Stir in the flour for 1 minute. Slowly add the broth and Worcestershire, stirring.
Return the beef. Cover and simmer on low until the beef is tender.
Boil the noodles in salted water until tender, then drain.
Serve the beef tips and gravy over the noodles.

recipes.title: Brown sugar ham steak with pineapple
recipes.blurb: Sweet and savory, done in 15 minutes

steps.text: Cut the ham steak into 4 pieces. Mix the brown sugar, mustard and pineapple juice.
Melt the butter in a large skillet over medium-high. Brown the ham pieces.
Flip the ham and add the pineapple slices around it.
Pour the glaze over everything. Simmer until syrupy, spooning it over.
Serve with rice or roasted potatoes.

recipes.title: Baked cod with buttery crumbs
recipes.blurb: Flaky cod under a crisp golden topping

steps.text: Heat the oven to 400°F. Grease a baking dish or line a pan with foil.
Pat the cod dry. Set it in the dish and season with salt and pepper.
Mix the panko, melted butter, Parmesan and garlic powder.
Press the crumbs on top of each fillet.
Bake until the topping is golden and the fish is 145°F and flakes.
Serve with lemon wedges.

recipes.title: Shrimp scampi with linguine
recipes.blurb: Garlic, lemon and butter, ready in 25 minutes

steps.text: Boil the linguine in well-salted water until al dente. Save 1/2 cup of the pasta water.
Heat the oil and 1 tbsp butter in a large skillet over medium. Cook the garlic and pepper flakes 30 seconds.
Add the shrimp, season with salt, and cook until pink.
Pour in the broth and lemon juice. Simmer 1 minute, then stir in the remaining butter.
Toss in the drained linguine and parsley. Loosen with pasta water if needed.

recipes.title: Sheet-pan shrimp boil
recipes.blurb: Shrimp, sausage, corn and potatoes with Old Bay

steps.text: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the potatoes with 1 tbsp oil and half the Old Bay on a large sheet pan.
Roast the potatoes by themselves first.
Add the corn and sausage. Drizzle with 1 tbsp oil and roast.
Toss the shrimp with the last oil and Old Bay. Add to the pan and roast until pink.
Drizzle with the melted butter and squeeze lemon over it all. Serve.

recipes.title: Pan-fried salmon patties
recipes.blurb: Budget-friendly canned salmon cakes with a crisp crust

steps.text: Flake the salmon into a bowl, removing any bones.
Stir in the eggs, panko, mayonnaise, green onions, mustard and pepper.
Shape into 8 patties about 1/2 inch thick. Chill 10 minutes.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium. Fry the patties until golden.
Flip and cook until golden and hot throughout.
Serve with lemon wedges.

recipes.title: Blackened tilapia
recipes.blurb: Smoky spiced fish in 10 minutes

steps.text: Mix the paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, cayenne, salt and thyme.
Pat the fillets dry and coat both sides with the spice mix.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high until hot.
Cook the fillets until dark and crusty.
Flip and cook until the fish is 145°F and flakes.
Serve with lime wedges.

recipes.title: Brown sugar glazed salmon
recipes.blurb: Sweet-spicy glaze, broiled until caramelized

steps.text: Heat the oven to 400°F. Line a sheet pan with foil and lightly oil it.
Whisk the brown sugar, mustard, soy sauce, oil and garlic into a glaze.
Set the salmon on the pan. Season with salt and pepper, then spoon the glaze over each.
Bake until the salmon is 145°F and flakes easily.
For a darker glaze, broil 1 to 2 minutes, watching closely.

recipes.title: Oven fish and chips
recipes.blurb: Crunchy baked cod fillets with seasoned potato wedges

steps.text: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the potato wedges with the oil and 1 tsp salt on a large sheet pan.
Roast the potatoes by themselves first.
Mix the panko, paprika and remaining salt. Coat the cod in flour, then egg, then panko.
Move the potatoes over. Add the cod and spray the tops with cooking spray.
Bake until the cod is 145°F and the crumbs are golden.
Serve with tartar sauce.

recipes.title: Pan-seared crab cakes
recipes.blurb: Mostly crab, lightly bound, with lemon-mayo sauce

steps.text: Gently mix the crab, panko, egg, 2 tbsp mayo, mustard, Old Bay and green onions. Do not break up the lumps.
Form into 8 small cakes. Chill so they hold together.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium. Cook the cakes until golden.
Flip and cook the other side until golden and hot.
Stir the lemon juice into the last 2 tbsp mayo. Serve with the cakes and lemon wedges.

recipes.title: Chicken pot pie
recipes.blurb: Creamy chicken and vegetables under a flaky crust

steps.text: Heat the oven to 400°F. Melt the butter in a large pot over medium and cook the onion until soft.
Stir in the flour for 1 minute. Slowly add the broth and milk, stirring, until thick.
Stir in the chicken, vegetables, thyme, salt and pepper. Remove from the heat.
Fit one crust in a 9-inch pie plate. Pour in the filling. Cover with the second crust, crimp, and cut 4 slits.
Bake until deep golden and bubbling. Cover the edge with foil if it browns too fast.
Rest 15 minutes before cutting.

recipes.title: Tuna noodle casserole
recipes.blurb: Creamy, crunchy-topped comfort from the pantry

steps.text: Heat the oven to 375°F. Boil the noodles 2 minutes less than the package says, then drain.
Melt the butter in a large pot. Cook the onion until soft.
Stir in the soup and milk until smooth. Add the tuna, peas and 1 cup cheese.
Fold in the noodles. Pour into a greased 9 by 13 inch dish.
Top with the rest of the cheese and the crushed chips.
Bake until bubbling and golden.

recipes.title: Baked macaroni and cheese
recipes.blurb: Real cheese sauce with a golden crumb top

steps.text: Heat the oven to 375°F. Boil the macaroni 2 minutes short of the package time, then drain.
Melt 3 tbsp butter in a pot. Whisk in the flour for 1 minute. Slowly whisk in the milk.
Cook, stirring, until thick enough to coat a spoon. Stir in the mustard, salt and 3 cups cheese.
Fold in the macaroni. Pour into a greased 9 by 13 inch dish and top with the last cheese.
Melt 1 tbsp butter, mix with the panko, and sprinkle over the top.
Bake until bubbly and golden.

recipes.title: Cheesy chicken broccoli rice casserole
recipes.blurb: Creamy rice bake with chicken and broccoli

steps.text: Heat the oven to 375°F. Grease a 9 by 13 inch baking dish.
Whisk the broth, soup, milk, garlic powder and salt. Stir in the rice and 1 cup cheese.
Add the chicken and broccoli and stir. Pour into the dish and cover tightly with foil.
Bake covered until the rice is tender and the chicken is 165°F.
Uncover, top with the rest of the cheese, and bake until melted.
Rest 5 minutes, then fluff and serve.

recipes.title: Shepherd's pie
recipes.blurb: Savory beef and vegetables under mashed potatoes

steps.text: Heat the oven to 400°F. Boil the potatoes in salted water until tender, then drain.
Mash the potatoes with 3 tbsp butter, the milk and salt.
Brown the beef with the onion and carrots in a large oven-safe skillet. Drain the fat.
Stir in the garlic, tomato paste and broth. Simmer until thickened, then add the peas.
Spread the potatoes over the filling. Dot with the last butter and rake with a fork.
Bake until bubbling and the top is golden.

recipes.title: Easy baked ziti
recipes.blurb: Pasta, meat sauce and gooey mozzarella

steps.text: Heat the oven to 375°F. Boil the ziti 2 minutes short of the package time, then drain.
Brown the beef and onion in a large pot. Drain the fat. Add the garlic and marinara.
Stir in the ziti, ricotta and 1.5 cups mozzarella.
Pour into a greased 9 by 13 inch dish. Top with the rest of the mozzarella and the Parmesan.
Cover with foil and bake.
Uncover and bake until the cheese is golden.

recipes.title: Cheeseburger casserole
recipes.blurb: Burger flavors baked with pasta and cheddar

steps.text: Heat the oven to 375°F. Boil the macaroni 2 minutes short of the package time, then drain.
Brown the beef and onion in a large skillet. Drain the fat.
Stir in the tomatoes, tomato sauce, broth, Worcestershire and salt. Simmer.
Mix in the macaroni and 1 cup cheese. Pour into a 9 by 13 inch dish.
Top with the rest of the cheese. Bake until bubbly and the beef is 160°F.

recipes.title: Cheesy ham and potato bake
recipes.blurb: Scalloped potatoes with ham, baked in one dish

steps.text: Heat the oven to 375°F. Grease a 9 by 13 inch baking dish.
Melt the butter in a pot. Cook the onion until soft. Whisk in the flour for 1 minute.
Slowly whisk in the milk. Simmer until thickened. Stir in 1 cup cheese, salt and pepper.
Layer the potatoes and ham in the dish. Pour the sauce over.
Cover with foil and bake until the potatoes are almost tender.
Uncover, top with the rest of the cheese, and bake until golden.

recipes.title: Classic beef chili
recipes.blurb: Thick, hearty and mildly spicy, even better the next day

steps.text: Brown the beef with the onion and pepper in a large pot, breaking it up. Drain the fat.
Stir in the garlic, chili powder, cumin and salt for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, beans and broth. Bring to a boil.
Lower the heat, cover partly, and simmer, stirring now and then.
Taste and add salt. Serve with cheese, sour cream or crackers.

recipes.title: Slow-cooker beef stew
recipes.blurb: Fork-tender beef, potatoes and carrots in a rich gravy

steps.text: Toss the beef with the flour, salt and pepper until coated.
Put the potatoes, carrots, onion and garlic in the slow cooker. Top with the beef.
Whisk the broth, tomato paste and thyme. Pour over the top.
Cover and cook on low until the beef is tender.
Stir in the frozen peas and cook until hot.
Stir and serve with crusty bread.

recipes.title: Broccoli cheddar soup
recipes.blurb: Creamy, cheesy and quick, like the cafe version

steps.text: Melt the butter in a large pot. Cook the onion until soft.
Stir in the flour for 1 minute. Slowly add the milk and broth, stirring.
Add the broccoli and carrot. Simmer, stirring now and then, until tender.
Turn the heat to low. Stir in the cheese a handful at a time until melted.
Season with salt. For a smoother soup, blend part of it with a stick blender.

recipes.title: Loaded baked potato soup
recipes.blurb: Creamy potato soup with bacon, cheddar and green onion

steps.text: Cook the bacon in a large pot until crisp. Move it to a plate and leave 2 tbsp fat in the pot.
Cook the onion in the bacon fat until soft. Stir in the flour for 1 minute.
Add the broth and potatoes. Simmer until the potatoes are tender.
Mash some of the potatoes right in the pot for a thicker soup.
Stir in the milk, cheese, sour cream and salt. Heat gently without boiling.
Top with bacon and green onions.

recipes.title: Vegetarian three-bean chili
recipes.blurb: Meatless chili with beans, peppers and corn

steps.text: Heat the oil in a large pot. Cook the onion and pepper until soft.
Stir in the garlic, chili powder and cumin for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, all three beans, corn and broth. Bring to a boil.
Lower the heat and simmer, stirring now and then, until thick.
Season with salt and serve with cheese, avocado or tortilla chips.

recipes.title: Classic cheeseburgers
recipes.blurb: Juicy skillet or grill burgers with melty American cheese

steps.text: Divide the beef into 4 loose balls. Flatten each to 3/4 inch, a bit wider than the bun. Press a dimple in the middle.
Season both sides with salt and pepper just before cooking.
Heat a skillet or grill to medium-high. Cook the burgers.
Flip. Cook until 160°F inside. Top with cheese for the last minute.
Toast the buttered buns in the pan until golden.
Build the burgers with lettuce, tomato and your toppings.

recipes.title: Sloppy Joes
recipes.blurb: Sweet-tangy beef on toasted buns

steps.text: Brown the beef with the onion and pepper in a large skillet, breaking it up. Drain the fat.
Stir in the garlic for 30 seconds.
Add the ketchup, brown sugar, Worcestershire, mustard and salt.
Simmer on low until thick, stirring now and then.
Toast the buns lightly.
Spoon the beef onto the buns and serve with napkins.

recipes.title: Philly cheesesteak sandwiches
recipes.blurb: Thin beef, peppers and onions with melted provolone

steps.text: Cook the onion and pepper in 1 tbsp oil in a large skillet until soft. Move to a plate.
Add the last oil. Cook the steak over high heat, stirring, until browned. Season with salt and pepper.
Return the vegetables. Pile the mixture into 4 mounds and top each with 2 slices provolone.
Cover until the cheese melts.
Split the rolls and toast lightly. Slide a mound into each roll.

recipes.title: Baked meatball subs
recipes.blurb: Tender meatballs, marinara and bubbly mozzarella

steps.text: Heat the oven to 400°F. Mix the beef, breadcrumbs, egg, Parmesan, salt and garlic. Roll into 18 meatballs.
Bake the meatballs on a lined sheet pan until browned.
Warm the marinara in a pot. Add the meatballs and simmer until they reach 160°F inside.
Split the rolls and set on a pan. Fill with meatballs and sauce. Top with mozzarella.
Broil until the cheese is bubbly.

recipes.title: Crispy chicken sandwiches
recipes.blurb: Buttermilk-marinated cutlets, pan-fried and crunchy

steps.text: Soak the cutlets in the buttermilk.
Mix the flour, paprika, salt and pepper in a dish.
Lift out a cutlet, let it drip, and press it into the flour mix on both sides.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high to about 350°F.
Fry the cutlets until deep golden and 165°F inside. Work in batches.
Drain on paper towels. Serve on toasted buns with mayo and pickles.

recipes.title: Classic tuna melts
recipes.blurb: Crisp-toasted bread, warm tuna and gooey cheddar

steps.text: Mix the tuna, mayonnaise, celery and mustard in a bowl.
Butter one side of each bread slice. Flip the bread so the butter side is out.
Spread the tuna on 4 slices. Top each with 2 cheese slices and a second slice of bread.
Cook in a skillet over medium-low until golden and the cheese melts.
Flip and toast the other side.
Cut in half and serve.

recipes.title: Black bean burgers
recipes.blurb: Hearty meatless burgers that hold together

ingredients.item: black beans (15 oz), drained and rinsed

steps.text: Mash the beans in a bowl, leaving some chunky. Stir in the panko, egg, rice, cumin, garlic powder and salt.
Shape into 4 patties and chill.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium. Cook the patties until crisp.
Flip carefully and cook until heated through.
Serve on buns with lettuce and your favorite toppings.

recipes.title: Juicy turkey burgers
recipes.blurb: Lean burgers with onion and Worcestershire for flavor

steps.text: Mix the turkey, panko, onion, Worcestershire, garlic powder and salt gently. Form 4 patties and press a dimple in the middle.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium. Cook the patties.
Flip and cook until 165°F inside.
Toast the buns and build the burgers with lettuce and your toppings.

recipes.title: Creamy mashed potatoes
recipes.blurb: Fluffy, buttery and lump-free

steps.text: Put the potatoes in a large pot, cover with cold water, and add the salt.
Bring to a boil, then simmer until a fork slides in easily.
Drain well and return to the hot pot for a minute to steam dry.
Mash with the butter. Pour in the warm milk a little at a time.
Stir in pepper and taste for salt. Serve hot.

recipes.title: Creamy coleslaw
recipes.blurb: Crisp and tangy picnic slaw

steps.text: Whisk the mayonnaise, sugar, vinegar, mustard, salt and pepper in a large bowl.
Add the coleslaw mix and toss to coat.
Chill so the flavors blend and the cabbage softens.
Stir, taste, and serve cold.

recipes.title: Classic potato salad
recipes.blurb: Creamy picnic potato salad with egg and pickle

steps.text: Boil the potatoes in salted water until just tender. Drain and let cool.
Cover the eggs with water, bring to a boil, then turn off the heat and cover. Let stand, then chill in cold water.
Peel and chop the eggs.
Stir the mayonnaise, mustard, relish, salt and pepper in a large bowl.
Fold in the potatoes, eggs, celery and green onions. Chill before serving.

recipes.title: Skillet cornbread
recipes.blurb: Golden, tender cornbread with crisp edges

steps.text: Heat the oven to 400°F. Put a 10-inch cast-iron skillet in the oven to heat.
Whisk the cornmeal, flour, sugar, baking powder and salt.
Whisk the milk, eggs and 4 tbsp butter. Stir into the dry ingredients until just combined.
Carefully add the last 2 tbsp butter to the hot skillet to coat it. Pour in the batter.
Bake until golden and a toothpick comes out clean.
Cool 5 minutes, then slice.

recipes.title: Green bean casserole
recipes.blurb: The holiday favorite with crispy onions

steps.text: Heat the oven to 350°F. Boil the green beans in salted water until crisp-tender, then drain.
Stir the soup, milk, soy sauce, pepper and 2/3 cup fried onions in a 2-quart baking dish.
Add the green beans and stir to coat.
Bake until bubbling.
Top with the remaining fried onions and bake until golden.

recipes.title: Homestyle baked beans
recipes.blurb: Smoky-sweet beans with bacon, slow-baked

steps.text: Heat the oven to 350°F. Cook the bacon in a skillet until crisp.
Add the onion and cook until soft.
Stir the beans, ketchup, brown sugar, mustard, Worcestershire and molasses in a 2-quart baking dish.
Mix in the bacon and onion.
Bake uncovered until thick and bubbly.
Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Honey glazed carrots
recipes.blurb: Tender, buttery carrots in 15 minutes

steps.text: Put the carrots, butter, honey, water and salt in a large skillet.
Bring to a boil, then cover and cook over medium heat until nearly tender.
Uncover and cook until the liquid becomes a glaze, stirring.
Sprinkle with parsley and serve.

recipes.title: Garlic roasted red potatoes
recipes.blurb: Crispy-edged potatoes with garlic and herbs

steps.text: Heat the oven to 425°F with a sheet pan inside.
Toss the potatoes with the oil, salt, pepper and rosemary.
Spread them on the hot pan in one layer. Roast, stirring halfway.
Stir in the garlic and roast until golden and crisp.
Serve hot.

recipes.title: Creamy macaroni salad
recipes.blurb: Cookout-style pasta salad, made ahead

steps.text: Boil the macaroni until tender, then drain and rinse with cold water.
Whisk the mayonnaise, vinegar, sugar, mustard, salt and pepper in a large bowl.
Add the macaroni, celery, pepper and onion. Stir to coat.
Chill so the pasta soaks up the dressing.
Stir, adding a splash of milk if dry. Serve cold.
